title: C40 Spech
prompt: Medium shot down a long dark vaulted stone corridor lit by two wall torches, one hooded spy in a black cloak sits hunched behind a rough wooden table, his face completely hidden in the shadow of the hood except two small glowing orange eyes, on the table lie stolen maps, letters and two daggers, wisps of bright orange chaos magic curl from his hands and around his shoulders, orange sparks, thin orange smoke. Background: dark corridor fading into cold dark teal mist. No text.

title: C08 Zazrak
prompt: Centered front view of a dark stone castle with many pointed towers standing on a heap of rubble and broken stones, a gigantic pillar of bright orange chaos energy erupts from the castle straight up into the sky, dozens of crackling bright orange lightning bolts branch out from the pillar in all directions, the tips of the towers glow orange, glowing orange cracks in the walls. No people. Background: dark smoky red-brown to black sky lit orange by the pillar. No text.

title: C13 Sabotaz
prompt: View deep into a round rocky mine tunnel receding into the distance, clusters of glowing blue-violet magic crystals grow on the walls, a web of crackling bright orange chaos lightning races along the tunnel and strikes the crystals, the crystals hit by lightning crack and burst into shards with orange sparks, rubble on the tunnel floor. No people, no mine cart. Background: cold dark teal rock, strong contrast of glowing orange chaos against cold dark teal. No text.
